attchmntText: Shivalik Rasayan Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Shivalik Rasayan Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13.11.2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Financial Results, both Standalone and Consolidated, for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 04:30 p.m. and concluded at 6:00 p.m. Enclosures include the financial results statement, segment-wise revenue and results data, and a Limited Review Report from M/s Rahul Chaudhary & Associates, Chartered Accountants. The approved financial results are available on the Company’s website at www.shivalikrasayan.com.
